corrections.summary: Health-insurance premiums: the canton figures labelled 'standard model (free choice of doctor)' were averages of other insurance models (BAG tariff type TAR-DIV) and about 10-13% too low (e.g. Zurich adult 2026: CHF 532.73 shown, CHF 591.21 correct). Recomputed from the official BAG premium data for 2026 and 2027; BAG's own average premium per canton added.
corrections.source: BAG / FOPH, Prämien_CH.csv and Archiv_Praemien_2026.zip (opendata.swiss), praemienregionen_<year>.xlsx (priminfo.admin.ch)
